title: A NeighborInfo neighbour whose low byte is 0 is matched as relay_node 0xFF
reasoning: Firmware sends a relayer whose low byte is 0 as relay_node 0xFF, so staging maps an origin, gateway or neighbour low byte of 0 to 0xFF before lnk_01 matches it (STATUS, interface agreed on 2026-11-14; ADR 0005, relay_node). c07 tests origin bytes; this case tests a neighbour byte.
c43-s (0x11) sends three packets to c43-g with relay_node 255. 0x11 is not 0xFF, so none is a direct hop (lnk_01).

Candidates are the senders of the radio deliveries c43-g heard in the 24 hours before each receipt: c43-g's own NeighborInfo at 08:00 (0x0A) and c43-s (0x11), for every receipt, the 10:10 one included: lnk_01, as PR #67 words Casey's Q2 answer (PR #66 comment 6968763406, item 2), says "a delivery exactly 24 hours before the receipt, and one at the receipt's own instant, are in the window", and each receipt is itself a radio delivery c43-g heard at its own instant. 0x11 is not 0xFF, so no outcome changes. c43-g's own Position of 22 October 09:00 is more than 24 hours before 10:10. c43-n's only delivery is its own Position, uplinked by itself, so c43-n is never a candidate at c43-g. No candidate has 0xFF, so relay_node does not resolve.

c43-g's own NeighborInfo at 08:00, within 24 hours before every receipt, lists c43-n with low byte 0 and c43-k with 0x30. Read as 0xFF, c43-n's byte is the only one equal to relay_node, so NeighborInfo resolves each receipt to c43-n. Only NeighborInfo resolves, so link_source is neighbor_info (lnk_01). An implementation that does not map the neighbour byte finds no neighbour with 0xFF and drops all three receipts by lnk_01.
Relayer c43-n and gateway c43-g differ (lnk_03); every RSSI and SNR is in range (lnk_06).

c43-n (20-bit cell n20) and c43-g (16-bit cell g16) each have one usable position inside the MSA in the 7 days before every receipt, so each is stationary with that cell as its box, and the hour's box is the same cell (lnk_02).
Distance between the box centres 2745.603 m, inside 500 to 60 000 m, and the cells' longitude intervals are disjoint (lnk_05). One box per end, 3 packets, median distance at least 500 m: kept.
Medians over the counted receipts: SNR 5, 6 and 7 dB give 6.0; RSSI -90, -95 and -100 dBm give -95.0 (lnk_04, percentile_cont).

position_uncertainty_m is the larger half-width of each end's box, n20 22.734410 m plus g16 363.750397 m, = 386.484807 m (lnk_05). Neither end is precise: n20 was sent on the public broker only, and g16 has fewer than 20 bits (pos_04).
